The following tables reference the requirements specified in [4, SRS BSW General]
and [5, SRS Flex Ray] and links to the fulfillment of these. Please note that if column
“Satisfied by” is empty for a specific requirement this means that this requirement is

Description

even mixed

BSW Modules shall support
pre-compile configuration
[SWS_FrIf_05069]

All AUTOSAR standard types and
constants shall be placed and
organized in a standard type header
file
[SWS_FrIf_05001]

All integer type definitions of target
and compiler specific scope shall be
placed and organized in a single type
header
[SWS_FrIf_05001]
[SRS_BSW_00358]
The return type of init() functions
implemented by AUTOSAR Basic
Software Modules shall be void
